title: How Ecommerce Brands Choose Corrugated Mailer Boxes for Product Shipping
buyer_question: How do ecommerce brands choose corrugated mailer boxes for product shipping?
short_answer: Ecommerce brands should choose corrugated mailer boxes by checking product size, product weight, shipping protection needs, flute direction, closure style, branding area, unboxing experience and logistics channel. The right mailer box should protect the product first and then support brand presentation.
